changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: Accent and case folding function for patient name search
changeSet.sql: create extension if not exists unaccent;

do $do$ declare ext_schema text; begin select n.nspname into ext_schema from pg_extension e join pg_namespace n on n.oid = e.extnamespace where e.extname = 'unaccent'; execute format( 'create or replace function clinlims.search_fold(text) returns text ' 'language sql immutable strict parallel safe as %L', format('select lower(%I.unaccent(%L::regdictionary, $1))', ext_schema, quote_ident(ext_schema) || '.unaccent')); end $do$;

changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: Trigram indexes on folded person names
changeSet.sql: create index if not exists idx_person_last_name_fold_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (clinlims.search_fold(last_name) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_person_first_name_fold_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (clinlims.search_fold(first_name) gin_trgm_ops);

rollback.sql: create index if not exists idx_person_last_name_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (lower(last_name) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_person_first_name_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (lower(first_name) gin_trgm_ops);
